      "title": "Stored timestamp validation still accepts incomplete dates",

      "defect": "Read delegates to the permissive DateTimeOffset parser and then checks only whether the text contains the parsed four-digit year. That does not prove a complete date was stored. A year-and-month value such as October 2026 supplies no day, but the parser supplies day 1 and the substring condition passes. A time-only value such as 12:34:56.2026 can also pass in 2026 because its fraction contains the read year while the parser supplies the current date. Earliest consumes the same results, so an incomplete link value can become a mapping creation time.",
      "evidence": [
        "The complete implementation is the TryParse/Contains expression at lines 27 to 32; Earliest selects through Read at line 41.",
        "The ten contract rows cover a plain time, a date without a year and complete alternative date ordering, but no year-and-month value or year digits in another component. The mapping rows likewise omit this boundary.",
        "The .NET 10 primary source GetDayOfYN and GetDayOfYM supplies day 1 (lines 1814 to 1844); CheckDefaultDateTime supplies absent date fields from the current date (lines 3612 to 3693). Fraction parsing is supported. These are source-derived counterexamples, not tests executed by this reviewer.",
        "The live FR-MCP-040 ac-1 explicitly requires partial dates to read as null and be ignored when mapping creation is chosen. It remains unsatisfied. The stored-reader binding passes in both supplied unit runs, which shows the supplied cases miss the defect."
      ],
      "sourceUrl": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dotnet/runtime/v10.0.0/src/libraries/System.Private.CoreLib/src/System/Globalization/DateTimeParse.cs",
      "changeToPass": "Validate that the stored representation actually supplies all date components before accepting it. Keep complete supported dates, stored offsets, null behavior and offset-less UTC semantics. Reject partial dates independently of the read clock; use that same validation for Earliest. Strengthen and prove the contracts before changing the implementation, then supply the required final-head evidence.",

No missing component is supplied from the current clock."
